author: N6rL
content: Done. Corpus: 4 happy-path fixtures (academic_pdf with bboxes, scanned_document OCR, web_article, edge_cases with Unicode and all optionals null/empty) + 1 negative fixture (unknown field). Python: 13 tests covering parametric parse, round-trip stability, and per-fixture field contracts — all in fast gate (no integration marker). Rust: 11 tests covering deserialize assertions per fixture, round-trip stability helper, negative/deny_unknown_fields guard (confirms LibraryError::Deserialization), negative/schema-version guard (confirms LibraryError::Validation), negative/bad-hash guard. All 24 tests green. Mutation baseline: N/A at M0 (manual trigger per ADR-006). Key finding: Python (Pydantic strict=True) silently ignores unknown fields — documented in test_python_permissive_unknown_field; Rust deny_unknown_fields is the authoritative membrane enforcer, confirmed by negative_unknown_field_rejected.
